overview: A clean, forward-only quiz app with a home screen, 10 multiple-choice questions, and a results screen showing your score. Answer all questions and see how many you got right.
features: Home screen with quiz intro and Start button
10 multiple-choice questions, one at a time
Progress indicator showing current question number
Answer highlighting when an option is selected
Results screen with final score, correct and incorrect counts
Restart button to retake the quiz from the beginning
